title: LLM Unlearning Reveals a Stronger-Than-Expected Coreset Effect in Current Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of 'unlearning' efficiency in LLMs using existing safety benchmarks like WMDP and MUSE. While it addresses safety-related knowledge removal, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary focus; its contribution is an empirical study of the 'coreset effect' in data removal processes.
